stories.title: Conservative cabinet sworn in with two Island ministers
stories.summary: Saanich South MLA Cathie Ounsted is the province’s new minister of Local Government, Housing, Sport and Culture, one of 19 ministers sworn in Friday.

stories.title: England captain Harry Kane is expected to miss 'a few months' with a left ankle injury
stories.summary: MUNICH (AP) — England soccer captain Harry Kane will miss the “next few months” after tearing a ligament in his left ankle during Bayern Munich’s 1-1 draw against Cologne on Friday.

stories.title: Magnitude 6.9 earthquake shakes Peru’s Andes, with no damage or casualties immediately reported
stories.summary: LIMA, Peru (AP) — A magnitude 6.9 earthquake shook the Andes in central Peru on Friday with no immediate reports of damage or casualties. The U.S. Geological Survey said the earthquake struck at 7:09 p.m. local time (0900 GMT Saturday).

stories.title: Promises of new B.C. government are a 'gargantuan' task, Doerkson says
stories.summary: VICTORIA — British Columbia has a new Conservative government after almost a century, along with a premier and a novice cabinet that now needs to fulfil a long list of promises made by Lorne Doerkson during the election campaign.

stories.title: Federal jury convicts man of starting the deadly 2025 Palisades Fire in Los Angeles
stories.summary: LOS ANGELES (AP) — The man accused of sparking last year’s deadly Palisades Fire was found guilty of arson charges Friday after his first federal case earlier this year ended in a mistrial .

stories.title: For families of the fallen, Trump’s proposed arch casts a shadow over Arlington National Cemetery
stories.summary: WASHINGTON (AP) — Cpl. Spencer Collart’s headstone faces the rising sun and the Lincoln Memorial to the east. The Marine Corps War Memorial is nearby. Soon, President Donald Trump's gilded, towering arch could be, too.

stories.title: Recent flooding damages dikes in B.C.'s Pemberton Valley: dyking district
stories.summary: About 50 to 60 homes in the Village of Pemberton have been "badly affected" by this month's torrential rain and flooding with repairs to the community's dikes expected to cost millions of dollars, the mayor said.

stories.title: Calgary man pleads guilty to threatening to kill PM Carney in YouTube posts
stories.summary: CALGARY — A Calgary man admitted in court Friday to posting an online threat to kill Prime Minister Mark Carney.
